entry: PROTOCOL Secs. 5.9 and 8.1: entered in Sec. 13 as part of the test freeze (selection.json, this record, the P4-P6 job files); job lines take utility and FRAMELEASE_V4_QNET (absolute) from job_lines
job_lines_rule: one job line per arm: utility (the network name), FRAMELEASE_V4_QNET (the absolute path, finding QNET-1) and qnet_file_sha256. Two arms may share a name (identical decision cores, e.g. two not trainable families) and the name pins neither B_pi nor the provenance, so the job generator identifies an arm by its arm key and pins qnet_file_sha256

items: GAP_AUDIT P3-2 ("bench_qnet.py: p50 / p99 against B_pi") is a hard gate here: deploy_check passes only when the featurize_forward p99 is at most B_pi = 100 us; PROTOCOL Sec. 5.7 defines B_pi only as the run-time bypass. The gate is stricter and changes no network.

GAP_AUDIT P3-5 ("time ope.select on a synthetic dataset of the expected size") is p3_rl.py calibrate: CPU-time probes of every part of an ope.select task at three sizes, a cost law c + a n ln n and one real ope.select at the smallest size as an in-sample check; it sets --n-jobs only, which is no stage parameter.

GAP_AUDIT Sec. 6 item 5: an a_det^{d*} head without support in a training fold is a regular unsupported evaluation (Amendment A6: ope.select marks the candidate unsupported in that fold and continues), so open case (a) covers a family that it leaves without a selectable candidate; open case (c) also covers a registered P2 run that the P2 data manifest does not list. Either is a deviation only when used (deviations).
